title: Verify: BootScene fades out and starts the scene on transitionTo unit tests
summary: Unit tests for transitionTo fade and scene start with Phaser mocked
description: Add a test file modelled on bootScenePlayAnimation.test.ts with Phaser mocked, asserting fadeOut and scene.start behavior.
acceptance_criteria: fadeOut called with the duration when transitionTo emitted
scene.start called with sceneId after FADE_OUT_COMPLETE
technical_constraints: Copy the vi.mock('phaser') and content mock from bootScenePlayAnimationShutdown.test.ts; add cameras.main.fadeOut and once as vi.fn, scene = { start: vi.fn() }, and Cameras: { Scene2D: { Events: { FADE_OUT_COMPLETE: 'camerafadeoutcomplete' } } }

steps.action: Create the file with the phaser mock extended as described and a describe block with two tests. Test 1: after boot.create(), reactToPhaser.emit('transitionTo', { sceneId: 'library' }) and assert cameras.main.fadeOut toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1). Test 2: after the emit, take the callback registered via cameras.main.once for 'camerafadeoutcomplete', invoke it, and assert scene.start toHaveBeenCalledWith('library') and that it was not called before invoking.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneTransitionTo.test.ts
